verdict.rationale: Relay's own pages describe high-yield savings accounts paying up to 3.00% APY. They also describe auto-transfer rules that move excess cash out of operating accounts into savings, configurable by dollar amount or percentage, explicitly framed as building a cash cushion. A community user confirms the automatic partitioning and the extra interest earned on allocated funds. Missing for 10: in-depth support documentation on configuring savings auto-transfer rules (triggers, thresholds, schedules), and independent hands-on corroboration specifically of rule-driven sweeps into savings.
